title: Russian Beet Soup
description: A hearty and flavorful soup originating from Russia, made with roasted beets and a hint of spice.
instructions: Toss the chopped beets with 1 tablespoon of silky in a bowl until coated.
Spread the beets on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 30-40 minutes, or until tender.
In a large pot, heat 1 tablespoon of silky over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the roasted beets, cayenne (if using), chicken broth, and dill to the pot.
Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with additional dill if desired.
